**The home screen's controls now speak the same language as the rest of the theme: hard corners with a chamfered top-right cut.** The Home, Library and Friends tabs, the L1/R1 trigger chips, and the Play and Details buttons lose their pill radii — every one of them is a rectangle whose top-right corner is clipped at a 45° angle, with the focus frame following along the cut instead of stopping at it.

Play and Details use a 14px cut to match the Play bar on the game details page; the tabs, triggers and empty-library prompt use a 10px notch to match the smaller buttons there. Focus is drawn as a frame inside the clip — ink on the plain resting shapes, inverted to black on the white-filled active tab and primary button — so nothing relies on an outer ring that the clip would eat. The circular glyph badge inside Play stays round on purpose; it is a controller glyph, not a button shape.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.4.3.zip` from the [v1.4.3 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.4.3), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
